04-06.title: Monday within the Octave of Easter10 white
extra: If necessary, the Chrism Mass may be celebrated on a suitable day before Holy Thursday.
Nine readings are assigned to the Easter Vigil: seven from the Old Testament and two from the New. If circumstances
demand in individual cases, the number of prescribed readings may be reduced. Three selections from the Old Testament,
both from the Law and the Prophets, should be read before the Epistle and Gospel. In any case, the reading from Exodus
about the escape through the Red Sea (reading 3) should never be omitted.
Although not given the title of Solemnity, “[t]he first eight days of Easter Time constitute the Octave of Easter and are
celebrated as Solemnities of the Lord” (Universal Norms on the Liturgical Year and the Calendar, no. 24).
